messages.content: when did gaurdians of the galaxy 2 come out

message.content:
*Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2* came out in the **United States on May 5, 2017**.[1][3][5]

It also had an earlier **international release starting April 25, 2017**, and premiered in Tokyo on **April 10, 2017**.[1][2]
